constitution present but no code to check against

owner_decisions.question: group membership source of truth
owner_decisions.decision: identity service owns groups; 014 builds them (group + group_membership in packages/services/identity, /api/v1/groups/*). Explicitly NOT Clerk Organizations.
owner_decisions.scope_effect: expands — new identity-service capability delivered under 014 (T-023..T-025)

owner_decisions.question: per-recipient FIFO ordering authority
owner_decisions.decision: SQS FIFO with MessageGroupId = recipient.id; routing consumer assigns a monotonic per-recipient sequence at dequeue; live push and replay both read that sequence.
owner_decisions.scope_effect: expands — queue provisioning + sequencer (T-026, T-027); FR-018 needs its own dedup store since SQS FIFO's dedup window is fixed at 5 minutes

findings.title: US-NNN ids denote different stories in product-spec and spec.md
findings.evidence: spec.md merged product-spec US-001+US-002 into one US-001, shifting all later ids by one; product-spec US-003 = group routing, spec.md US-003 = global broadcast. plan.md's 'Must Have: US-001..US-007' resolves differently per artifact.

findings.title: FR-008/FR-009 per-recipient FIFO ordering has zero plan coverage
findings.evidence: plan.md contains 0 occurrences of FIFO, ordering, partition, or MessageGroupId, despite a three-path hybrid architecture and SC-002 gating launch on zero out-of-order deliveries.

findings.title: Group-membership lookup delegated to plan.md, never defined, closed by fiat in tasks.md
findings.evidence: spec.md A-002 requires a placeholder lookup 'defined in plan.md'; plan.md has 0 mentions of group membership. Q-002 is still open in product-spec and review.md. T-005 asserts a '002 group membership API' that feature 002 does not specify and the identity service does not expose.

findings.title: Producers 012 and 013 are mandatory in plan.md but have no task
findings.evidence: Plan mandates 003, 005, 008, 009, 012, 013. tasks.md covers 003 (T-017) and 005/008/009 (T-018). Zero tasks reference 012 or 013.

findings.title: verify-report.md measures a non-existent task graph and carries a stale finding
findings.evidence: Report cites T001-T066 / 53 tasks / Phase 7 T057-T066; tasks.md defines 20 tasks T-001..T-020. Report W-003 claims MISSING cells in traceability-matrix.md; that file has 0 occurrences of MISSING across 31 mapped REQ rows. Its C-001 (release audit blocked, 186 untested) remains accurate.

findings.title: spec.md US-009 messageType registry enforcement has no product-spec story
findings.evidence: Capability entered via the Q-005 resolution and is implemented by plan.md, tasks.md T-014 and v-model REQ-016/REQ-017, but was never promoted into the product-spec story map.

findings.title: research/codebase-analysis.md is materially false against the current repository
findings.evidence: Claims no folders exist for cited references (5 services + 4 shared packages now exist) and 'No existing in-app notification UI primitive on the client' — both web and mobile ship an inert notifications control in HomeTopBar.tsx:114 whose source comment states 'there is no notifications service in v1'. No 014 artifact mentions this shipped affordance.

findings.title: Three plan commitments have no corresponding task
findings.evidence: No task for counter-based canary checks, for removal of producer-local delivery implementations (the GR-011 ownership proof), or for the environment flags gating progressive producer enablement.

findings.title: review.md GR-007 conformance evidence is false
findings.evidence: Row asserts 'Tasks explicitly require @kitchensink/recipe-core'; tasks.md has 0 occurrences of recipe-core and T-002 creates @kitchensink/notification-types. The package choice is defensible; the evidence claim is not.

findings.title: NFR-001 and NFR-003 have no plan coverage
findings.evidence: No availability budget, latency budget, measurement point, or definition of 'nominal load' in plan.md. SC-004 and the k6 tier depend on these numbers.

findings.title: Previous sync run's markdown and JSON outputs disagree
findings.evidence: Run #1 (2026-06-02) recorded WARNING 0 in markdown and warning 1 in JSON, with critical 0 in both, while DRIFT-001..005 were already present. Layer lists also disagree.

findings.title: Durable retention specified down to the ORM with no data model in plan.md
findings.evidence: FR-012 requires >=24h retention and T-009 names Drizzle ORM + PostgreSQL, but plan.md has no Data Model section. Because that section is absent, the Phase 5.5 migration-plan trigger never fires — the phase that would catch this gap is disabled by the gap.

late_findings.title: user-journey.md Journey C promises offline retrieval of global broadcasts; spec.md excludes it
late_findings.evidence: Journey C: 'disconnected clients retrieve it later if still relevant'. spec.md scopes retention to user and group recipients and states offline globals are dropped. Opened as product-spec Q-009 for the revalidation gate.

late_findings.title: feature README.md states the core artifacts do not exist
late_findings.evidence: README claimed the folder was 'Bootstrap only' and did not yet contain spec.md, plan.md, tasks.md or v-model/. All four have existed since the 007-014 reconciliation commit.

reconciliation_debt.item: v-model chain predates the 2026-08-05 scope additions
reconciliation_debt.detail: The 31 REQ-NNN rows map 1:1 to spec.md's 23 FR + 8 NFR as of 2026-05-13. They do not cover the identity group model, the ordering/sequence authority, or the client bell surface. Must be regenerated (not hand-patched) before T-020 closes the M8 exit gate.
Marked superseded in place; regenerated by Phase 7 after implementation.

standing_risk.description: Of the six producers plan.md makes mandatory for M8, only 003 exists in code. 005, 008, 009, 012, 013 are specification-only, so T-018 and the DRIFT-004 tasks cannot complete until those features ship.
